item.title: Blue Note to bring world-famous jazz club to London
item.summary: Grammy-winning pianist Robert Glasper will headline opening of club’s first UK venue in Covent Garden next month The world-famous New York jazz club Blue Note will open its first UK venue in London next month. Located in the basement of St Martins Lane hotel, Covent Garden, the club promises the best of British jazz alongside world-class international artists, with a programme featuring emerging and established talent.
